references.context: Shoot the right orbit from the left flipper. Let the ball return through the top lanes.
references.label: Top Key lanes
references.description: The upper lanes collect Keys 1 through 4.

references.context: Shoot the narrow Grotto chute from the right flipper.
references.label: Grotto chute
references.description: The narrow upper-left chute collects the lit Grotto numbers.

references.context: When Keys 1 through 4 are complete, shoot the center Key 5 standup.
references.label: Center Key 5
references.description: The center standup completes the five-Key set.

references.context: Shoot the right orbit from the left flipper. Let the ball return through the top lanes.
references.label: Right orbit
references.description: The upper-right orbit returns the ball through the top lanes.

references.context: Complete the five Playmate standups once to light the star rollover for Extra Ball. A second set lights the star for Special.
references.label: Playmate targets
references.description: The left-middle standup bank advances bonus when lit.

references.context: Complete the five drop targets once to light the outlanes for 25,000. A second bank awards Special.
references.label: Drop targets
references.description: The right-middle drop bank lights outlane value after completion.

references.context: Complete the five Playmate standups once to light the star rollover for Extra Ball. A second set lights the star for Special.
references.label: Star rollover
references.description: The left-center rollover collects a lit Extra Ball or Special.
